versions.name: equal-v1
versions.note: Equal-weight log-odds average of the simulator and the team model; the headline through October 7, 2026.

versions.name: taught-v3
versions.note: Our model taught by the market's closing lines on simulations with the run environment; the headline adds the market's pregame line (the several-books average when at least three books are read, else DraftKings). Replaced taught-v2 before it took effect (DISTILL-03, HEADLINE-03 in LEDGER.md).

ours.fitted_on: least squares on the market's closing log-odds (vig removed), 4,140 regular-season games: 2025 through August 16 and 2026; simulator at 1,000 worlds per game with the run environment, all inputs from prior dates
ours.checked: taught on 2025 alone and scored on 2026 results: Brier 0.24354 (2.59% better than a coin) against 0.24370 for the equal blend; taught on 2026 and scored on 2025: 0.24228 against the closing line's 0.24235

headline.fitted_on: fixed weights chosen on 2025 and 2026 results, each season scored with our model taught on the other season's market

versions.name: taught-v4
versions.note: Our model taught by the market's closing lines on simulations with the production settings: run environment, team offsets (TEAM-05) and base running (RUN-02). Two inputs, the simulator's and the team model's log-odds: with the production simulations the starter and rating terms of taught-v3 no longer transfer between seasons (their weights change sign from one season to the other), and the two-input model is as good or better on every cross-season check (HEADLINE-04 in LEDGER.md).

ours.fitted_on: least squares on the market's closing log-odds (vig removed), 4,140 regular-season games: 2025 through August 16 and 2026; simulator at 1,000 worlds per game with the run environment, team offsets and base running, all inputs from prior dates
ours.checked: taught on 2025 and scored on 2026: market log-odds R squared 0.816, Brier 0.24363; taught on 2026 and scored on 2025: R squared 0.738, Brier 0.24154 against the closing line's 0.24235; the weights agree between seasons (0.565 and 0.558 taught on 2025, 0.536 and 0.522 taught on 2026)
